# Roman Resenchuk

Roman Resenchuk is an experienced Apple platform developer with over a decade of experience building native applications for iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS.

## Expertise
- Native Apple app development
- Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, AppKit
- Modern Apple frameworks and architecture
- App Store delivery and product development lifecycle

## Services
- iOS and macOS application development
- Apple platform consulting
- UI implementation and product engineering
- Full-cycle app development from concept to release
